name: umd-player
long_description: A UMD Video player for the PS Vita, Windows, Linux (Steam Deck and Steam Machine included) and macOS. It plays the movies, TV episodes and concerts that Sony sold on UMD for the PSP, from `.iso`, `.cso` or `.zso` disc images. On the Vita it runs natively: no Adrenaline, no PSP firmware. It can also play a disc through its own menus, as a PSP does.
